items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Carpenter started showing me different things concerning phrases on the trumpet and I've always considered him my first teacher

ctx.x: I went home after the week was over but I had lost my job at Western Union, and my father was not happy about me staying away longer than I was supposed to and had no job when I came back. A trumpet player named Theodore Carpenter had left a carnival and was now playing with Clarence Page and I met him. Carpenter had only one arm having lost his left one in an accident somewhere on a machine that had pulled his arm off up to the shoulder. But that was no handicap for him when it came to playing his horn. He could…

Carpenter was called "Wingy" by the musicians. Wings is slang for arms and there is not many instruments after a trumpet that a one-arm person can play. Because of the 3 valves, the trumpet can be held by the little finger and the thumb whereas a trumpet player with both hands can hold the trumpet with one hand and the other is free to manipulate the valves.
Freddie Jenkins fingered the trumpet with his left hand because he had lost the joints of the upper part of the digits on his right hand.
